items.exampleEn: He got his diving qualification during a holiday in Thailand.
items.exampleZh: 他在泰國度假時取得了潛水資格。

items.exampleEn: The inexperienced players were nervous before the big game.
items.exampleZh: 那些經驗不足的球員在大賽前很緊張。

items.exampleEn: The skillful mechanic fixed my car in twenty minutes.
items.exampleZh: 那位技術熟練的技工二十分鐘就修好了我的車。

items.exampleEn: The girl skillfully folded the paper into a bird.
items.exampleZh: 那個女孩熟練地把紙摺成一隻鳥。

items.exampleEn: My workaholic sister often eats dinner at her desk.
items.exampleZh: 我那個工作狂姊姊常常在辦公桌前吃晚餐。

items.exampleEn: The book was written in simple words for nonprofessional readers.
items.exampleZh: 這本書用簡單的文字寫給非專業的讀者看。

items.exampleEn: Engineers are usually well-paid in this country.
items.exampleZh: 在這個國家，工程師的薪水通常很高。

items.sentenceEn: The driver skillfully parked the large bus in a very small space.
items.sentenceZh: 司機熟練地把那輛大巴士停進一個很小的空位。

items.audioEn: I took the job because it's well-paid, but I have to work most weekends.
items.audioZh: 我接下這份工作是因為薪水高，但大部分週末都得上班。
options: Busy on most Saturdays and Sundays

items.sentenceEn: My boss is a workaholic who answers emails even on holiday.
items.sentenceZh: 我老闆是個工作狂，連放假都在回電子郵件。

items.sentenceEn: The photos were taken by nonprofessional photographers from the village.
items.sentenceZh: 這些照片是村裡的業餘攝影師拍的。

items.stemEn: Because the new waiter was ____, he dropped two plates on his first day.
items.stemZh: 因為新來的服務生經驗不足，他第一天就摔破了兩個盤子。

items.stemEn: This short course gives you a ____ in computer skills.
items.stemZh: 這門短期課程能讓你取得電腦技能的資格。

items.passageEn: Our hotel is looking for a new head chef. This is a well-paid position, but it is not for everyone. We need someone with a cooking qualification and at least five years of experience in a busy kitchen, so inexperienced cooks should not apply. The chef must work skillfully under pressure and lead a team of ten. We are not looking for a workaholic: our employees work fixed hours and have two days off every week. Many of our best dishes were first created by nonprofessional cooks in our annual family recipe contest, and the new chef will judge it. A skillful chef who enjoys teaching will feel at home here.
items.passageZh: 本飯店正在徵求一位新的主廚。這是個高薪的職位，但不是人人都適合。我們需要具備烹飪資格、並在忙碌廚房至少有五年經驗的人，所以經驗不足的廚師請勿應徵。主廚必須能在壓力下熟練地工作，並帶領一個十人的團隊。我們不找工作狂：我們的員工上班時間固定，每週休兩天。我們許多最好的菜色，最早都是業餘廚師在一年一度的家庭食譜比賽中做出來的，新主廚將擔任這個比賽的評審。熱愛教學、技術熟練的主廚，在這裡會有家的感覺。

questions.questionZh: 這份工作需要什麼條件？
options: 能說三種語言並帶過大團隊
在飯店住宿並隨時待命
每個月幫飯店設計新的菜單
擔任家庭食譜比賽的評審

items.promptZh: 她希望找到一份高薪又有趣的工作。
referenceEn: She hopes to find a well-paid and interesting job.
She hopes to get a job that is interesting and well-paid.
rubricZh: well-paid 可放在名詞前或 be 動詞後（例如 a well-paid job、a job that is well-paid 等）
「希望」可寫，例如 hopes to、wants to 等

items.promptZh: 這位理髮師剪頭髮的技術非常熟練。
referenceEn: This barber is very skillful at cutting hair.
The barber cuts hair in a very skillful way.
rubricZh: skillful 可放 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 is very skillful at 等）；寫 cuts hair very skillfully 也正確
「剪頭髮」可寫，例如 cutting hair、cuts hair 等
